source_notes: Common 38-pin ESP32-WROOM-32 devkit footprint; mounting-hole span from widely-sold devkit variants, not one specific vendor's drawing.
Aosong DHT22/AM2302 datasheet body dimensions; no standard mounting holes, typically zip-tied or bracket-clipped.
IEC 60086 standard 18650 cell envelope. w=diameter, h=length. Held by a battery holder part, not screw-mounted, so no mount_spec.

28BYJ-48 datasheet: 28mm body diameter, 19mm body depth. Two mounting ears at 35mm center-to-center -- wider than the 28mm body, so the ear tips sit outside the round body itself; G3a's own hole-clamp step pulls the drawn holes back inside the body's footprint rather than drawing them off the part.

Common 12mm THT piezo buzzer footprint. w=case diameter, h=case height (dome + base). Two-pin through-hole leads, not a real screw mount -- mount_spec here approximates lead spacing for hole-primitive fidelity.
Standard 6x6mm THT tact switch, plunger height included in h. No real screw mount -- through-hole legs only, so no mount_spec.
Waterproof stainless-steel probe variant (not bare TO-92), common 6mm x 50mm probe body. Cable-mounted, no screw mount, so no mount_spec.
